blocks.text: Sell my house in Surrey: current prices, the 2024 lot rules and a free home evaluation
Cloverdale real estate market stats for September 2026: benchmark prices and trends

faq.q: What is this page — a neighbourhood guide or an index?
faq.a: An index. The page, headed "The three Cloverdale areas," links one guide for each Cloverdale MLS® area — Cloverdale BC, Clayton and Serpentine — each covering schools, parks, planning and what to check before buying, and it carries no single-neighbourhood profile of its own.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Cloverdale Neighbourhood Guides?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Cloverdale Neighbourhood Guides is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
